text: F05 locally complete. Bootstrap now refits raw whole-subject samples with fresh original preprocessing and unique identities for repeated subjects; derives rank from fitted loadings rather than absent ncomp metadata. Independent class-mean SVD oracle verifies loading units, changed bases, aligned scores and duplicate weighting. Failed/rank-deficient draws retained and counted; >=2 valid draws required, unsupported residual-component fits rejected. Seeded schedules reproducible; rank-one shapes and tied-root NA/subspace policy tested. Existing BaDA, summary, alignment and generic inference suites exit0, pre-existing residual complex-coercion warnings retained. Default alpha remains one-sided .05 (90% central intervals); experimental coverage/exchangeability not established. Before/after logs and F05-source-hashes.json retained.
